findings.title: Per-layer score range contract is not enforced by the runner before shared reports can be produced

evidence.summary: The accepted scorer contract defines each layer score as integer 0 through 5 and requires adaptive-vs-baseline per-layer comparison.
The plan requires per-layer score output plus baseline/adaptive score fields and per-layer adaptive >= baseline regression checks.

Runnable validation does not reject out-of-range baseline/adaptive scores; only adaptive is mapped to the core scorer, and per-layer pass/fail can mark adaptive values above the pass threshold as PASS before emitting raw score values.
No focused runner tests cover baseline/adaptive values below 0 or above 5.

findings.impact: Invalid baseline/adaptive score values can enter shared JSON, JSONL, and Markdown evidence. Baseline out-of-range values are not surfaced by the core scorer, and adaptive values above 5 can receive a per-layer PASS label while row-level reasons may still report out-of-range. This violates the accepted score contract and blocks commit readiness.
findings.required_fix: Validate every layer baseline_score and adaptive_score as 0..5 before scoring/report construction; return EVAL_ONLY_INPUT_VALIDATION_FAILED with no report writes for invalid values; add focused tests for both lower and upper bound failures and valid 0/5 boundary values; regenerate evidence and rerun targeted checks.

boundary_assessment.project_standards_and_operation_result_b: FAIL: OperationResult behavior is mostly covered, but invalid score contract input can still produce shared evidence instead of validation failure.
boundary_assessment.tests_coverage_vs_accepted_work_order: FAIL: focused tests do not cover baseline/adaptive score range contract.

non_blocking_observations.summary: Top-level execution state still says after code-review-pass-02 fix while the active evidence folder contains pass-03 fix and pass-04 PASS review. This is documentation drift, not the blocking reason, because phase/scope/next-action/claim locks remain closed.
